periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the black eye patches are oriented diagonally, angled approximately 45 degrees upward and outward from the rostrum's central axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit a high aspect ratio, appearing as elongated ovals with the vertical-oblique length significantly exceeding the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a distinct downward tapering, where the inferior margin of the patch extends further from the geometric center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band at the lateral flanks appears thick, occupying approximately one-third of the visible upper torso's vertical profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely set, separated by a distance approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears are characterized by a smooth, rounded convex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: The ventral fur exhibits a pronounced yellowish-brown discoloration compared to the white fur of the head.
